lines.text: A little note can break glass.
Beautiful. A new path is open.
You broke that with your voice. I need to sit down. I don't have legs.

directions.label: Warm Nimble
directions.description: An original English-speaking mascot voice for Merc, an ageless liquid-metal adventure sprite who reads as a young adult. Androgynous with a light-mid register, warm rounded timbre, agile conversational pace, a ready smile and a small natural musical lift. Nimble, curious and companionable, with quick comic timing. Crisp natural articulation for short game dialogue. Dry, close-mic studio recording with excellent audio quality; no music, background sound or reverb. Moderate conversational volume, never shouting. A friendly encouraging coach: precise and playful, never childish, squeaky, shrill, nasal, announcer-like or imitative.

directions.label: Bright Playful
directions.description: An original English-speaking mascot voice for Merc, an ageless liquid-metal adventure sprite who reads as a young adult. Feminine-leaning and bright with a clear light register, energetic but controlled, playful quick timing and a mischievous spark. Expressive pitch movement without sing-song exaggeration. Crisp natural articulation for short game dialogue. Dry, close-mic studio recording with excellent audio quality; no music, background sound or reverb. Moderate conversational volume, never shouting. A friendly encouraging coach, never childish, squeaky, screechy, shrill, breathless, announcer-like or imitative.

directions.label: Grounded Wry
directions.description: An original English-speaking mascot voice for Merc, an ageless liquid-metal adventure sprite who reads as a young adult. Masculine-leaning and grounded with a warm low-mid register, compact resonance, calm confidence and understated dry comic timing. Deliberate but not slow, with a subtle smile and only a slight musical lift. Crisp natural articulation for short game dialogue. Dry, close-mic studio recording with excellent audio quality; no music, background sound or reverb. Moderate conversational volume, never booming or shouting. A friendly encouraging coach, never cynical, gravelly, trailer-like, announcer-like or imitative.

directions.label: Gentle Whimsical
directions.description: An original English-speaking mascot voice for Merc, an ageless liquid-metal adventure sprite who reads as a young adult. Soft and androgynous with a clear intimate register, gentle warmth, quiet wonder and an easy unhurried rhythm. Lightly melodic and whimsical while remaining natural, intelligible and emotionally present. Crisp articulation for short game dialogue. Dry, close-mic studio recording with excellent audio quality; no music, background sound or reverb. Moderate-to-soft conversational volume, never shouting. A friendly encouraging coach, never wispy, sleepy, childish, squeaky, shrill, announcer-like or imitative.
